title: Gameplay, equipment and graphics design index
scope: Implementation designs and dated source audits; these do not assert that pending features are in a published binary.
precedence: EQUIPMENT-PURCHASE-PROGRESSION-DESIGN.json governs every shop prerequisite and paid/grant/recovered provenance.
COMPONENT-PROGRESSION-DESIGN.json governs real-stat promotion, excess preservation and finite family templates.
SHIELD/NAVIGATION/ENERGY module designs govern family names, standard systems, actual effects and legacy mapping.
SALVAGE-GAMEPLAY-DESIGN.json governs specialized controls, source-weighted finite loot, immediate fitting and PLUGH alien workshop.
GAMEPLAY-SYSTEMS-DESIGN.json governs ecology, police, crime and asteroid mining foundations.
DRAWING-MODES-DESIGN.json governs scene styles/defaults and strictly qualified graphics-performance evidence.
Audit JSON files are dated observations of their captured source, not claims of current feature completion.
release_documentation: README, controls/equipment guides, delivery backlog and GitHub Release notes must identify actually shipped behaviour, signed artifact source SHA and remaining planned work. Final player-facing stats/prices/templates come from implemented authoritative data, not provisional design tuning.
ownership: Orchestrator owns these design/audit JSON artifacts. Elite Coder1 owns integration/publication and player guides; Coder2 owns renderer/loot evidence; Mission researcher independently owns docs/research. Do not stage another owner WIP as completed documentation.
